### What is this?

<!-- One or two sentences. Which section, and what is being added or changed. -->

- [ ] `_news/` — something that happened (primary source linked)
- [ ] `_papers/` — an annotated research entry
- [ ] `_roadmaps/` — a signed proposal
- [ ] `_systems/` — code, a benchmark, a reproduction
- [ ] `_concepts/` — a definition for the wiki
- [ ] `_problems/` — an open problem
- [ ] `_profiles/` — my own contributor page
- [ ] a correction or edit to an existing entry

### Checklist

- [ ] One entry per pull request
- [ ] Front matter is complete for this section (see `/contribute/`)
- [ ] `uid` does not collide with an existing entry
- [ ] Filename is kebab-case and I am happy for it to be the permanent URL
- [ ] Internal links use absolute site paths (`/wiki/…/`, `/papers/…/`)
- [ ] Sources are linked; prior work is credited
- [ ] For `_news/`: `source:` is a **primary** source, and `date:` is when it happened
- [ ] For `_news/`: I removed the `published: false` line from the template
- [ ] `bundle exec jekyll build` succeeds locally
- [ ] I agree to publish this text under CC BY 4.0 and any code under MIT
